**Why the app can't answer it today**

**If this is a new machine topology or a physical effect**

A reference helps a great deal — a paper, a build log, or the equations. The solver
takes new topologies as a list of kinematic terms rather than as derived equations of
motion, so a clear description of the geometry and its degrees of freedom is usually
enough to implement it. See `CLAUDE.md` for what that means in practice.
